text: The time is always right to do what is right.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

text: Nothing in life is to be feared; it is only to be understood.
author: Marie Curie

text: How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world.
author: Anne Frank

text: You have power over your mind—not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

text: If there is no struggle, there is no progress.
author: Frederick Douglass

text: Great things are not done by impulse, but by a series of small things brought together.
author: Vincent van

text: The most effective way to do it is to do it.
author: Amelia Earhart

text: Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed is more important than any other.
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: 為せば成る 為さねば成らぬ何事も 成らぬは人の為さぬなりけり
author: 上杉鷹山

text: Well done is better than well said.
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: I have learned that success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has overcome while trying to succeed.
author: Booker T. Washington

text: I have learned over the years that when one’s mind is made up, this diminishes fear.
author: Rosa Parks

text: 夢なき者に理想なし。理想なき者に計画なし。計画なき者に実行なし。実行なき者に成功なし。故に、夢なき者に成功なし。
author: 吉田松陰
